extended:
**Overpartitions, lattice paths, and Rogers-Ramanujan identities** — Sylvie Corteel and Olivier Mallet. HAL hal-00017295 v2, submitted 21 Dec 2006.

Extends partition-theoretic work of Andrews, Bressoud and Burge to overpartitions, defining successive ranks, generalized Durfee squares, and generalized lattice paths in that setting.

**Why it may bear here.** Rogers-Ramanujan identities and the Rogers dilogarithm are named in this corpus's Φ_q / Li₂^q context-sorting; this is the partition-combinatorics side. Thematic adjacency, not an established use.

**Extraction caveat.** The held PDF opens with HAL deposit boilerplate, so its automatic title read that boilerplate; the real title page is the second page.
